payload.body: You tend to smooth over the issue, handle it yourself, or leave before anyone can object, then wonder why the same irritation returns. The habit still solves enough of the problem to feel useful and fails enough to keep the real want out. This often happens because the strategy was built for an earlier situation with fewer choices. Replace one automatic response with a direct request.
payload.astroHint: Lilith quincunx the South Node can make an old coping strategy keep working while continuing to cause resentment.

Black Moon Lilith marks raw instinct that refuses to be tamed, shamed, or controlled, and the place where autonomy and unfiltered truth are reclaimed. The want stops being a secret and starts being a plan. Aspect operation: Quincunx puts mismatched functions together and requires repeated adjustment. Traditional nature: awkward, requires adjustment.
